steps.text: Talk to the Observatory professor north of Castle Wars.
Give the professor a bronze bar.
Give the professor some molten glass.
Enter the dungeon east of the Professor.
Search only the marked chests in the dungeon. Unmarked chests contain monsters and may poison you.
Prod the sleeping guard in the north of the dungeon. He'll attack you. You need to then either kill him, or get him in the marked spot to the north of the gate.
Either kill or trap the guard on the marked tile to the north, then search the goblin stove.
Climb the stairs back to the surface.
Give the professor the lens mould. If you don't have it, check your bank.
Use the molten glass on the mould.
Give the professor the lens mould and lens.
Enter the dungeon east of the Professor.
Follow the dungeon around anti-clockwise to a staircase, then climb it.
Climb up the stairs in the observatory.
Tell the professor which constellation you observed.
